name: Vigilante Phenomenon
body:
Employing psionic powers, you strengthen your body, befuddle your enemies, and control the world around you.

Class Skills

You gain a number of skill ranks per level equal to 4 + your Intelligence modifier.

Autohypnosis and Knowledge (psionics) are class skills for you, but Device Disable, Knowledge (engineering), Perform, and Sleight of Hand are not.

This feature alters class skills and skill ranks.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

You are not proficient with medium armor.

This feature alters weapon and armor proficiency.

Psionics

You gain power points per day, powers known, and maximum power level known as a dread, but you choose your powers known from the psion/wilder power list.

Only psion/wilder powers of 6th level and lower are considered to be part of the phenomenon power list.

This feature replaces the 4th-, 8th-, 10th-, 14th-, and 16th-level vigilante talents.

Psionic Talents

At 1st level, you gain two psionic talents of your choice, selected from the psion/wilder power list. Talents are 0-level psionic powers that are powered by psionic focus, rather than power points. These talents do not count against your powers known.

Psionic Attacks (Ex)

At 1st level, you gain your choice of Psionic Fist, Psionic Shot, or Psionic Weapon as a bonus feat. At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you gain a cumulative +1 bonus to damage rolls with weapon attacks and unarmed strikes while maintaining your psionic focus.

This feature replaces vigilante specialization.

Phenomenon Talents

You can select from any of the following vigilante talents, in addition to general vigilante talents.

This feature alters vigilante talents.

Empowered Psionics (Su)

You can manifest one power per day as if it were modified by the Empower Power feat. This does not expend your psionic focus nor increase the power point cost to manifest the power. You must be at least 6th level before selecting this talent. You gain one additional use per day of this ability at 12th level, and again at 18th level.

Maximize Psionics (Su)

You can manifest one power per day as if it were modified by the Maximize Power feat. This does not expend your psionic focus nor increase the power point cost to manifest the power. You must be at least 9th level before selecting this talent. You gain one additional use per day of this ability at 15th level.

Mind Blade (Su)

You gain the form mind blade, shape mind blade, throw mind blade, and enhanced mind blade features, as the soulknife class. You use your vigilante class level –2 as your effective soulknife level. You must be at least 4th level before selecting this talent.

Psionic Feat: You gain any one feat with the Psionic descriptor. You must meet the prerequisites for the feat chosen. You can select this talent more than once; each time, select a different feat whose prerequisites you meet.

Psionic Maneuver Master (Ex)

You have mastered one type of combat maneuver: bull rush, disarm overrun, sunder, or trip.

You gain your choice of Psionic Bull Rush, Psionic Disarm, Psionic Overrun, Psionic Sunder, or Psionic Trip as a bonus feat, as well as the “Improved” feat that serves as its prerequisite (for example, Improved Bull Rush). You do not need to meet any other prerequisites for these feats. Whenever you are attempting the selected maneuver, you use your vigilante level in place of your base attack bonus to determine your CMB (in addition to any base attack bonus gained from other classes). You can select this talent more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time you select it, you must select a different combat maneuver to which it applies.

Psionic Strike (Su)

As a standard action, you can expend your psionic focus to make a melee touch attack that deals damage of the same type as your active energy type. The amount of damage dealt is equal to 1d6, plus an additional 1d6 at 3rd level and every two vigilante levels thereafter.

Quicken Psionics (Su)

You can manifest one power per day as if it were modified by the Quicken Power feat. This does not expend your psionic focus nor increase the power point cost to manifest the power. You must be at least 12th level before selecting this talent.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
